method: empirical SE from 4,000 paired bootstrap resamples of the committed Vietnam REPORT per-case scores, extrapolated as SE proportional to 1/sqrt(n); required n = n0 * ((z_alpha + z_beta) * SE0 / delta)^2
assumptions: the new cohort has a case mix, negative-class spectrum and score distribution similar to the Vietnam screening cohort
one image per patient, so cases are independent
paired design: both arms scored on identical patients
prevalence 0.104, as observed in Vietnam REPORT
AUROC differences of this size behave approximately normally
no adjustment for multiple comparisons; add one if more than a single primary endpoint is tested
caveat: these numbers describe the power to detect a difference between two arms on the SAME cohort. They say nothing about the cohort size needed to estimate absolute performance to a given precision, which is a different and usually smaller requirement.
